saw.short: Gordon Ramsay is the new Top Gear host
saw.headline: *Gordon Ramsay* is the new Top Gear host
saw.what: The BBC confirmed Gordon Ramsay as lead host of a revived Top Gear on BBC One and iPlayer in 2028, per Radio Times, Variety and Metro. Filming runs across the UK and abroad in 2027, with Dunsfold and The Stig returning. Ramsay announced it in a social video with The Stig, captioned “It’s official! Gordon Ramsay is your new host”, per Digital Spy.
saw.why: A huge TV hosting reveal with a social-first announcement. Expect reaction takes all week.
saw.source: Radio Times, 25 Nov; Variety, 25 Nov; Metro, 25 Nov

saw.short: Man City wear a fourth, orange kit in the Champions League
saw.headline: *Man City* wear a fourth, orange kit in the Champions League
saw.what: Man City wore a special-edition orange Puma x C.P. Company kit against Napoli on Tuesday, in a 2-2 draw, per Metro and the BBC. The BBC says it is a fourth kit, so it can’t be worn in the Premier League, where clubs may use only three. The collection goes on sale globally on Tuesday 1 Dec, per the club.
saw.why: A kit launch that is also a fashion collaboration. Fans split on the look.

saw.headline: Strictly’s *week 10 dances* are revealed, with Instant Dance returning
saw.what: Seven couples remain on Strictly, and Digital Spy lists the week 10 dances: Delta and Kai get a Couples’ Choice to AC/DC, Cach and Maddie a Viennese waltz to “Feeling Good”, and Lacey and Vito a waltz to “Chasing Cars”. Instant Dance returns for every couple on Saturday 28 Nov. We have the list from Digital Spy only.
saw.why: Song choices give fans something to predict. Saturday is the next big night.

saw.short: I'm A Celebrity mid-week: Joanna Page's socks and Wayne's foot spa
saw.headline: *I’m A Celebrity* mid-week: Joanna Page’s socks and Wayne’s foot spa
saw.what: Joanna Page admitted she hasn’t changed her socks in nine days in camp, per Metro. Coleen Rooney said on ITV’s Unpacked that Wayne’s electric foot spa luxury item was first going to be a chair, per Digital Spy. We’ve left trial results out.
saw.why: Light camp chat that keeps the show in feeds between big moments.

saw.short: Disney's Hexed opens in the US ahead of UK cinemas on Friday
saw.headline: Disney’s *Hexed* opens in the US ahead of UK cinemas on Friday
saw.what: Deadline projects Hexed will take about $7.8 million on Wednesday, including $2.1 million of previews, and $35–40 million over five days. Deadline puts critics at 67% fresh and its soundtrack includes Queen, Little Mix, Dua Lipa and Demi Lovato. Hailee Steinfeld sings a cover of “Magic” over the credits. These are Deadline’s early estimates, and we haven’t seen UK reaction yet.
saw.why: Our client’s film week. US numbers set the mood before the UK release.

saw.short: M&S launches a Chocolate & Clementine sandwich
saw.headline: *M&S* launches a Chocolate & Clementine sandwich
saw.what: M&S launched a limited-edition Chocolate & Clementine sandwich on Tuesday, at £3 for one half, per Metro. It follows the viral Strawberry & Creme and Chocolate & Pistachio versions. Metro says the pack states 5% of sales go to Shelter, and commenters are divided. We found no second source.
saw.why: A retail launch built for TikTok food-haul culture. A repeatable format.

platform.short: Meta launches its Muse AI agent in the UK
platform.headline: *Meta* launches its Muse AI agent in the UK
platform.what: Meta says Muse, its personal AI agent, launched for UK adults on iOS, Android, muse.ai and WhatsApp on 24 Nov, free with optional paid plans. UK partners include M&S, Currys, Argos, Sainsbury’s, ASOS, JD Sports and MyProtein. Muse asks before sending emails or buying. The CMA said the same day that UK consumer law applies to AI agents.
platform.why: A new AI agent that can shop for people. Retail clients will want to know how it surfaces them.
platform.source: Meta, 24 Nov; Social Media Today, 24 Nov; CMA

platform.short: Discord launches Auto Clips in early access
platform.headline: *Discord* launches Auto Clips in early access for Nitro members
platform.what: Discord says Auto Clips detects spikes of laughter or shouting in voice calls and saves the moment locally on your PC. It rolls out in early access to Nitro members over the coming weeks, with event-based clipping for League of Legends, Rocket League, Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2. Discord says calls stay end-to-end encrypted. The blog’s date is 23 or 24 Nov.
platform.why: Gaming communities get an easy way to share highlights. Early access only.
